'''Brolan Windhorn''' is a [[tauren]] [[quest giver]] located at [[Sagh's Refuge]] in the [[Thousand Needles]].

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Horde|27|The Need to Survive}} {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
My family has long lived within the Thousand Needles. It is our ancestral home, and a place that we have walked for what seems to be countless generations. Now all of our lives have been upended, and we find ourselves nothing more than refugees.

:''What happened to make you refugees?''

:The Blackwind is what happened. A vile group of Grimtotem murderers and savages led by one named 'Shalk' who is their chieftain. They invaded our sacred home, Windhorn Canyon almost a month ago.

:The devastation they brought was horrid, so many innocents were slain in their bloodlust and conquest. Now my tribe has been left to wander, to find a new place to call home... Atleast what is left of us.
